title: Paired coordinate equivalence
statement: For natural numbers $r$ and $k$, define a linear equivalence from the space of $mathbb{F}_2$-valued vectors with $r+2k$ coordinates to itself recursively. At $k=0$ it is the identity; at $k+1$, split a vector into a block of $r+2k$ coordinates and its final two coordinates, add the sum of the block’s coordinates to each final coordinate, apply the equivalence for $k$ to the block, and reassemble the coordinates.
